headline: **MLB Daily Recap: June 22, 2026**
article:
The Cincinnati Reds secured a 4-1 victory over the New York Yankees, with Chase Burns earning the win after pitching 5.0 innings with 7 strikeouts and 1 earned run. The Milwaukee Brewers also secured a win, taking down the Atlanta Braves 9-4 behind a strong performance from their pitching staff. Robert Gasser earned the win with 6.0 innings pitched, 7 strikeouts, and 2 earned runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Blas Castaño of the Colorado Rockies, who has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right pectoral strain. The Miami Marlins have also suffered injuries, with Josh Ekness being transferred to the 60-day injured list and Liam Hicks being placed on the 10-day injured list. Other notable injuries include Luis Severino of the Athletics, Jack Leiter of the Texas Rangers, Adley Rutschman of the Baltimore Orioles, Blake Treinen of the Los Angeles Dodgers, and Isiah Kiner-Falefa of the Boston Red Sox.

The Atlanta Braves bolstered their rotation with the acquisition of right-handed pitcher Tyler Schoff in a trade with the Washington Nationals. Other notable trades include the Houston Astros trading Jayden Murray to the Chicago Cubs for Cameron Sisneros, the Arizona Diamondbacks trading Luis Urías to the Toronto Blue Jays for cash, and the Pittsburgh Pirates acquiring Hunter Stratton from the Atlanta Braves for Joey Bart.

top_news.summary: The Milwaukee Brewers secured a 9-4 victory over the Atlanta Braves, led by a strong performance from their pitching staff. Robert Gasser earned the win with 6.0 innings pitched, 7 strikeouts, and 2 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall Short in Tampa**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals dropped a 3-4 decision to the Tampa Bay Rays, unable to overcome a late deficit. Jonny DeLuca led the Nationals' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, including a key homer that scored Yandy Díaz.

top_news.title: **Tigers Take Down White Sox in Thrilling Finish**
top_news.summary: The Detroit Tigers edged out the Chicago White Sox 5-4 in a closely contested matchup. Dillon Dingler led the Tigers' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run performance, driving in 2 runs.

top_news.title: **Rockies RHP Castaño Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Colorado Rockies right-hander Blas Castaño has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to a right pectoral strain, effective retroactive to June 18, 2026.

top_news.title: **Braves Bolster Rotation with Trade Acquisition**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves have acquired right-handed pitcher Tyler Schoff in a trade with the Washington Nationals.
